title: D77-TC Pelican (Halo)
intro: The Pelican is the fictional dropship of the UNSC in the Halo games and series. It can fly in space and hover like a helicopter (VTOL). Pilot and co-pilot sit in the nose cockpit, which the games show mostly in cut-scenes; behind is a troop bay with a ramp.

panels.name: Cockpit
panels.text: The nose cockpit with the pilot's and co-pilot's seats, screens and the chin gun.
panels.context: The pilot flies, the co-pilot helps; the games show it mostly in cut-scenes.

controls.name: Pilot seat
controls.text: The pilot's seat with the flight controls of the Pelican.
controls.context: The pilot flies the dropship in and out of the battle zone.

controls.name: Co-pilot seat
controls.text: The second seat beside the pilot in the Pelican's cockpit.
controls.context: A co-pilot can help with the systems or take over.

controls.name: Displays
controls.text: Screens show the flight and the weapons data.
controls.context: They help the pilot land in the right place and use the gun.

controls.name: Chin gun
controls.text: An autocannon, a fast-firing gun, in the nose of the Pelican.
controls.context: It protects the dropship while it drops off troops.

areas.name: Troop bay
areas.text: The rear bay with a ramp.

panels.name: Troop bay
panels.text: The bay at the back for troops, with a ramp and a clamp for a vehicle.
panels.context: The Pelican's job is to carry soldiers and vehicles to the fight.

controls.name: Rear ramp
controls.text: A ramp at the back opens for the troops to board and leave.
controls.context: The Pelican lands or hovers while the soldiers run out.

controls.name: Vehicle clamp
controls.text: A clamp under the tail holds a vehicle that hangs below the Pelican.
controls.context: This way the dropship can bring a ground vehicle to the battle.

controls.name: Troop seats
controls.text: Seats along the walls of the bay for the soldiers.
controls.context: The soldiers ride here until the ramp opens.

areas.name: Flight controls
areas.text: The hand controls the pilot flies with.

panels.name: Flight controls
panels.text: The pilot's flight controls in the Pelican's cockpit.
panels.context: They steer the dropship in space and in the air.

controls.name: Flight controls
controls.text: The flight controls tip the nose up and down and roll the dropship left and right.
controls.context: The games show them only in cut-scenes.

panels.name: Thrust
panels.text: The thrust control of the Pelican (the catalog's guess).
panels.context: It sets how hard the engines push.

controls.name: Thrust
controls.text: This axis is taken as the control for the engines' thrust.
controls.context: The catalog guesses this control; the games do not show it clearly.
